# Local atlas dependencies

- `d3-7.9.0.min.js`: D3 7.9.0, https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7.9.0/dist/d3.min.js (ISC, see D3-LICENSE).
- `topojson-client-3.1.0.min.js`: TopoJSON client 3.1.0, https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/topojson-client@3.1.0/dist/topojson-client.min.js (ISC, see TOPOJSON-LICENSE).
- `../data/land-110m.json`: world-atlas 2.0.2, https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/world-atlas@2.0.2/land-110m.json. Natural Earth 1:110m land geometry; Natural Earth data is public domain. Package license: `../data/WORLD-ATLAS-LICENSE`.

These files are pinned and served by AETERNUS; no CDN calls are made at runtime.
